pages.text: Summoning the Divine Heavenly Dao takes a $(item)Dragon Soul$() and one of each element source:$(li)$(item)Wood Source$(): 20% from zombies (incl. husks, drowned, zombie villagers) killed by a player$(li)$(item)Gold Source$(): 20% from iron golems killed by a player$(li)$(item)Fire Source$(): 20% from blazes killed by a player$(li)$(item)Earth Source$(): 5% when a player digs dirt or grass$(li)$(item)Water Source$(): 10% when filling an empty bucket outdoors in the rain

Carry the sources and right-click the $(item)Mystery Altar$() while holding a Dragon Soul: a 20-second countdown begins in that dimension while golden motes stream into the altar. Then a $(l)golden sigil$() unfolds in the sky and the $(l)Divine Heavenly Dao$() descends through it amid endless lightning (your camera follows).$(br2)Nothing is consumed if something is missing or a summoning is already running in the dimension.
